description: This file defines the I18NTranslation entity for the OrangeHRM system, including ORM mappings, properties, and methods for managing translation data related to internationalization.

classes.name: I18NTranslation
classes.description: Entity class representing a translation entry for internationalization, with properties for language, string, value, and metadata, and ORM mappings.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the translation record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the translation record.

methods.name: getLangString
methods.description: Returns the associated language string object.

methods.name: setLangString
methods.description: Sets the associated language string object.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Returns the language object for this translation.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description: Sets the language object for this translation.

methods.name: isCustomized
methods.description: Checks if the translation has been customized.

methods.name: setCustomized
methods.description: Sets whether the translation is customized.
